project.title: Influenza B-derived peptide presentation by HLA-B*07:02, -B*08:01 and -B*35:01
project.projectDescription: Analysis of peptide presentation by Human Leukocyte Antigen (HLA) class I of influenza B infected C1R cells expressing HLA-B*07:02, -B*08:01 or -B*35:01.
project.sampleProcessingProtocol: C1R.B*07:02, C1R.B*08:01 and C1R.B*35:01 cells were infected Influenza B virus (B/Malaysia/2506/04), or left uninfected, prior to isolation of HLA-I molecules using the pan HLA-I antibody W6/32. Peptide-HLA were dissociated with 10% acetic acid and fractionated by reversed-phase high-performance liquid chromatography. Peptide containing fractions were vacuum-concentrated, reconstituted in 0.1% formic acid and analysed by LC-MS/MS on a Q-Exactive Plus Hybrid Quadrupole Orbitrap (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
project.dataProcessingProtocol: Data were searched against the reviewed human proteome (downloaded from UniProt March 2022) and influenza B/Malaysia/2506/04 virus proteome plus the 6 frame translated nucleotide sequence of influenza B/Malaysia/2506/04 virus using PEAKXPRO v10.6 (Bioinformatics Solutions Inc). False Discovery Rate (FDR) analysis was performed by decoy-fusion.  Settings:  Instrument: Orbitrap (Orbi-Orbi), Fragment: HCD, Acquisition: DDA, Associate Chimera Scan: Enabled, Parent Mass Error Tolerance: 10.0 ppm, Fragment Mass Error Tolerance: 0.02 Da, Precursor Mass Search Type: Monoisotopic, Enzyme: None, Digest Mode: Unspecific, Variable Modifications: Oxidation (M) +15.99 Da, Cysteinylation +119.00 Da and Deamidation (NQ) +0.98 Da, Max Variable PTM Per Peptide: 3.
